intro: Sad kaomoji (also spelled sad kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces for low moods — disappointment, gloom, sulking, and loneliness — without the full tears of a crying kaomoji. A sad kaomoji like (´･_･`) or (◞‸◟) is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse disappointed, gloomy, sulking, and lonely faces below and click any face to copy it instantly.
